name: The gear curve (44 R10, GR-4): BUILT on lane/c-pace in src/data/gear-curve.js, a band every +17% from Level 110, the line linear in the band's Level
why: From Level 110 a MID or BiS hero's weapon and armor are the line (the tier-7 sample x the band Level / 110) at the band at or under its Level: 110, 129, 151, 176, 206, 241, 282, 330, 386 and on by +17% (src/data/gear-curve.js GEAR_CURVE bandStep 1.17, bandAt). LOW wears one band back. The plan step plays the same bands the game's curve now answers, so this patch and bp-gear-step-117.json are one step: GR-4's row can name either, and both read as built once lane/c-pace merges. Weapons: +17% MEASURED (12-balance-pass.md 3.6). Armor: still the probe's open item (D-3); the armor lines join src/data as rows of the same curve in the armor half
